# Full Stack

These projects span the whole pipeline — pulling data from an external API, storing and modeling it, running analysis on top, and surfacing it through an interactive interface.

- [Canvas-Risk](Full_Stack/project1.qmd) — a Canvas LMS integration with a SQLite-backed data layer, a weighted risk-scoring engine, and a live terminal dashboard
